otra.Si no hay vuelo conveniente a Puerto Nat: If there is no convenient flight to Puerto Natales, fly to Punta Arenas (PUQ) and take a ~3 h bus to Puerto Natales.
otra.El vuelo directo desde Santiago llega al: The direct flight from Santiago lands on the Brazilian side (Foz do Iguaçu, IGU); the Argentine side is ~40 min away across the border.
otra.Desde San Pedro de Atacama hay tours en: From San Pedro de Atacama there are 3-day 4x4 tours that end in Uyuni: it is the most common way to get there from Chile.
otra.También hay cruceros de expedición de 10: There are also 10 to 12-day expedition cruises from Ushuaia.
otra.También se llega en ferry desde Punta Ar: You can also get there by ferry from Punta Arenas (~30 h through the channels) or by boat from Ushuaia in season.

notas.Transfer compartido desde el aeropuerto,: Shared transfer from the airport, ~100 km
notas.Buses diarios en temporada (oct a abr),: Daily buses in season (Oct to Apr), early departure
notas.Buses y colectivos frecuentes desde el t: Frequent buses and shared taxis from the terminal
notas.Transfer desde el aeropuerto; la ruta se: Transfer from the airport; the route is driven in a rental car
notas.Quebrada de Humahuaca; conviene auto arr: Quebrada de Humahuaca; a rental car or tour is best
notas.Taxi o bus; el lado argentino y el brasi: Taxi or bus; the Argentine and Brazilian sides are visited on different days
notas.PeruRail o Inca Rail; reserva con antici: PeruRail or Inca Rail; book in advance
notas.La entrada al santuario se compra aparte: Entry to the sanctuary is sold separately and has limited spots
notas.Bus o tour; se sube a más de 4.800 m: Bus or tour; it climbs above 4,800 m
notas.Incluye un cruce corto en lancha por el: Includes a short boat crossing over the Strait of Tiquina
notas.Bus o taxi; desde Salento se va al valle: Bus or taxi; from Salento you go to the Cocora Valley
notas.Bus hasta la entrada El Zaino: Bus to the El Zaino entrance
notas.Bus, ferry corto por el canal de Itabaca: Bus, short ferry across the Itabaca Channel and taxi
notas.Shuttle con cruce en lancha por el lago: Shuttle with a boat crossing over Lake Arenal
notas.Auto o tour; el borde oeste queda a ~2 h: Car or tour; the West Rim is ~2 h away
notas.Tren o bus; Córdoba queda a 45 min en tr: Train or bus; Córdoba is 45 min away by high-speed train
notas.Bus SITA por la costa; en verano también: SITA bus along the coast; in summer there are also ferries
notas.Bus directo; para pueblos chicos convien: Direct bus; for small villages a car is best
notas.Tren directo o con un cambio en Berna: Direct train or one change in Bern
notas.Valle de cascadas; desde ahí trenes de m: Valley of waterfalls; mountain trains leave from there
notas.Auto arrendado o tour; cascadas Seljalan: Rental car or tour; Seljalandsfoss and Skógafoss waterfalls
notas.Tren con cambio en Myrdal; desde Flåm sa: Train with a change in Myrdal; boats leave Flåm through the fjord
notas.Van compartida o tour por la Ruta Milita: Shared van or tour along the Military Road
notas.Vuelo interno; también hay tren nocturno: Domestic flight; there is also a ~10 h night train
notas.Por tierra con el operador del safari; t: Overland with the safari operator; there are also ~1 h light aircraft
notas.Van compartida; también hay vuelos direc: Shared van; there are also direct flights to El Nido from Manila
notas.Lancha rápida o hidroavión, según el ato: Speedboat or seaplane, depending on the atoll
notas.El tramo panorámico entre plantaciones d: The scenic stretch through tea plantations
notas.Vuelo interno; en bus son ~7 h: Domestic flight; by bus it's ~7 h
notas.Tren rápido; Agra queda a ~2 h de Delhi: High-speed train; Agra is ~2 h from Delhi by train
notas.Lancha: el aeropuerto está en un islote: Boat: the airport is on an islet
notas.Avionetas regionales; también hay ferry: Regional light aircraft; there is also a ~9 h ferry
notas.Solo con operador autorizado; el clima p: Only with an authorized operator; weather can delay the flight
notas.Auto arrendado o excursión; ballenas de: Rental car or excursion; whales from Jun to Dec
notas.Bus o transfer desde el aeropuerto, ~170: Bus or transfer from the airport, ~170 km
notas.Camión 4x4 por las dunas: no entran auto: 4x4 truck over the dunes: private cars are not allowed
notas.Bus o transfer; también hay Tren Maya: Bus or transfer; there is also the Tren Maya
notas.Tren panorámico, de mayo a septiembre; p: Scenic train, May to September; Kenai Peninsula
notas.Bus; o lancha Alilaguna directo a San Ma: Bus; or Alilaguna boat straight to San Marco (~1 h 15)
notas.Tren regional; Cannes queda a ~30 min ha: Regional train; Cannes is ~30 min in the other direction
notas.Bus o auto por la costa; Ksamil queda ~2: Bus or car along the coast; Ksamil is ~2 h further south
notas.Auto arrendado; el desierto de Wahiba qu: Rental car; the Wahiba desert is ~2 h further
notas.Vuelo interno; por tierra son 1 a 2 días: Domestic flight; overland it's 1 to 2 days
notas.Taxi o bus; desde ahí, casas flote por l: Taxi or bus; from there, houseboats through the canals
notas.Con el operador del safari; también hay: With the safari operator; there are also ~1 h light aircraft
notas.Ferry rápido; también hay vuelos de 15 m: Fast ferry; there are also 15-min flights
notas.Con el operador; el permiso para gorilas: With the operator; the gorilla permit is bought in advance
notas.Auto o bus por Panguipulli; también se l: Car or bus via Panguipulli; you can also get there from Temuco (~3 h)
notas.Auto o tour; las zonas cambian cada año: Car or tour; the areas change every year (Llanos de Challe, Huasco, Vallenar)
notas.Auto o bus; Antillanca queda ~1 h más ar: Car or bus; Antillanca is ~1 h further up
notas.Sector El Amarillo; conviene auto o tran: El Amarillo sector; a car or transfer is best
notas.Bus; desde Encarnación las ruinas de Tri: Bus; from Encarnación the Trinidad ruins are ~30 min away
notas.Bus o auto; el circuito completo toma 3: Bus or car; the full circuit takes 3 to 4 days
notas.Bus o transfer; Belo Horizonte queda en: Bus or transfer; Belo Horizonte is on the way
notas.Tren turístico entre bosque atlántico: Tourist train through the Atlantic Forest
notas.Bus o transfer; Canela queda a 15 min: Bus or transfer; Canela is 15 min away
notas.Ferry rápido; también salen ferries a My: Fast ferry; ferries also leave for Mykonos and Santorini (5 to 8 h)
notas.Tren regional desde Milano Centrale; a C: Regional train from Milano Centrale; there are direct ~40 min trains to Como San Giovanni. From Malpensa to Milan, Malpensa Express (~50 min)
notas.Bus o tour desde el resort Ayers Rock; e: Bus or tour from the Ayers Rock Resort; the airport is next to the resort
notas.Tren regional; para los châteaux del Méd: Regional train; for the Médoc châteaux a tour or car is best
notas.Transfer o tour; ahí están las piscinas: Transfer or tour; the Galés natural pools are there

requisitoNotas.Cédula o pasaporte vigentes y en buen es: Valid ID card or passport in good condition. Tourist stay up to 3 months, extendable for another 3.
A valid ID card is enough (Mercosur agreement). The 90-day stay is approximate: the Brazilian source could not be opened.
requisitoNotas.Turismo solo con cédula vigente. Migraci: Tourism with a valid ID card only. Immigration sets the days on entry (max. ~180 per year). Declare luggage at customs.
requisitoNotas.Chile está en Grupo I (sin visa). 30 día: Chile is in Group I (no visa). 30 days, extendable up to 90 per year at Bolivian Immigration. A valid ID card works.
requisitoNotas.Hasta 90 días. Por vía aérea completar e: Up to 90 days. When arriving by air, fill in the Check-MIG between 72 and 1 hour before the flight (not at land borders).
requisitoNotas.Se acepta cédula de ciudadanos sudameric: ID cards of South American citizens are accepted. 90-day tourist stay under general rules (not detailed on the cited page).
requisitoNotas.Cédula vigente basta. Estadía de 90 días: A valid ID card is enough. The 90-day stay is approximate: no official Uruguayan source with the limit was found.
requisitoNotas.Solo pasaporte válido. Máx. 180 días; el: Valid passport only. Max. 180 days; the immigration officer decides. Bring a return ticket and bookings.
requisitoNotas.Formulario e-Ticket gratuito obligatorio: Free e-Ticket form required (eticket.migracion.gob.do). Tourist card included in the ticket. Over 30 days, a fee is paid on departure.
requisitoNotas.Desde 2025 la tarjeta de turista fue ree: Since 2025 the tourist card has been replaced by an electronic visa (evisacuba.cu), up to 90 days. You must also register in D'Viajeros.
requisitoNotas.Chile en Grupo 1: hasta 180 días. Pedirá: Chile is in Group 1: up to 180 days. They will ask for an onward ticket and funds (US$100 per month of stay).
requisitoNotas.Chile está en la lista de exentos de vis: Chile is on the visa-exempt list. Maximum tourist stay of 3 months. Valid passport.
requisitoNotas.ED card online obligatoria (hasta 7 días: Online ED card required (up to 7 days before). US$20 sustainability fee per air arrival. Immigration sets the length of stay.
requisitoNotas.Chile en Categoría A (exento). Hasta 90: Chile is in Category A (exempt). Up to 90 days in the CA-4 region (Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua), extendable.
requisitoNotas.Chile exento de visa según manual unific: Chile is visa-exempt under the unified CA-4 manual (not found on the Honduran site). 90 days shared across the CA-4 region.
requisitoNotas.Chile está en Visa Waiver. ESTA vale 2 a: Chile is in the Visa Waiver Program. ESTA is valid for 2 years, up to 90 days per trip. Fee US$40.27; rises to US$40.62 from ~16 Oct 2026.
requisitoNotas.eTA para llegar en avión: CAD 7 (~US$5),: eTA for arriving by air: CAD 7 (~US$5), valid up to 5 years or until the passport expires. Stays are usually up to 6 months.
ETIAS is not operating yet (no official date). No visa for 90 days in 180; EES biometric registration at the border.
requisitoNotas.ETA obligatoria: £20 (~US$27), múltiples: ETA required: £20 (~US$27), multiple trips for 2 years or until the passport expires; up to 6 months per visit.
requisitoNotas.Schengen. ETIAS aún no opera (sin fecha: Schengen. ETIAS is not operating yet (no official date). No visa for 90 days in 180; EES biometric registration at the border.
requisitoNotas.Schengen (aplica lista UE de exentos). E: Schengen (EU list of exempt countries applies). ETIAS is not operating yet (no official date). No visa for 90 days in 180; EES biometric registration at the border.
requisitoNotas.Pasaporte ordinario exento de visa hasta: Ordinary passport holders are visa-exempt for up to 90 days.
requisitoNotas.Hasta 1 año sin visa (no confirmado en s: Up to 1 year without a visa (not confirmed on an official Georgian site). Travel health insurance is mandatory since 1 Jan 2026.
requisitoNotas.Máx. 90 días en 180 en Schengen. Registr: Max. 90 days in 180 in Schengen. EES biometric registration at the border. ETIAS is not operating yet: the EU announced it for late 2026, with no confirmed date.
requisitoNotas.Chilenos exentos de visa de turismo. Est: Chileans are exempt from tourist visas. 90-day stay according to secondary sources; Morocco's site (consulat.ma) could not be opened to confirm.
requisitoNotas.Chile figura en el portal oficial de e-V: Chile is listed on the official e-Visa portal: USD 30 single entry, USD 65 multiple. Passport valid for 6 months. Visa on arrival not confirmed by an official source.
requisitoNotas.Exentos por 90 días con pasaporte ordina: Exempt for 90 days with an ordinary passport, free of charge. A passport with 2 blank pages is recommended.
eTA required (Chile is not exempt). From USD 30; processing ~3 business days, apply ≥2 weeks before. Stay length not stated in the official source.
requisitoNotas.Chile habilitado para visa online y a la: Chile is eligible for online and on-arrival visas. Ordinary visa USD 50, up to 90 days. Applying online avoids queues.
requisitoNotas.Sello gratuito a la llegada: múltiples e: Free stamp on arrival: multiple entries, valid for 6 months, max. 90 days in total. Bilateral visa waiver agreement (2017).
requisitoNotas.Visa 40 JOD (~USD 56), válida 1 mes. Gra: Visa 40 JOD (~USD 56), valid for 1 month. Free with the Jordan Pass if you stay at least 2 nights. Chile is not a restricted nationality.
requisitoNotas.Exención de visa por 90 días para turism: 90-day visa exemption for tourism with an ordinary passport.
requisitoNotas.K-ETA obligatoria: KRW 10.000 (~USD 7),: K-ETA required: KRW 10,000 (~USD 7), apply ≥72 h before. Chile is not in the temporary K-ETA exemption until 31 Dec 2026.
requisitoNotas.90 días por acuerdo bilateral; no afecta: 90 days under a bilateral agreement; not affected by the cut to 30 days of 15 Sep 2026. Fill in the TDAC online (free) before arriving.
requisitoNotas.e-VOA online o VOA en aeropuerto: IDR 50: Online e-VOA or VOA at the airport: IDR 500,000 (~USD 30), 30 days extendable by 30 more. The official country list could not be opened.
requisitoNotas.Acuerdo bilateral vigente desde 2017: ha: Bilateral agreement in force since 2017: up to 90 days with an ordinary passport valid for 6 months.
requisitoNotas.30 días iniciales. Pasaporte con 6 meses: 30 days initially. Passport valid for 6 months and an onward ticket within 30 days. Free eTravel registration before traveling.
requisitoNotas.Gratis, 30 días. Declaración IMUGA ≤96 h: Free, 30 days. IMUGA declaration ≤96 h before; accommodation booking, onward ticket and sufficient funds.
requisitoNotas.ETA turista USD 50 online (USD 60 a la l: Tourist ETA USD 50 online (USD 60 on arrival), 30 days, double entry. Chile is not among the 40 countries with a free ETA (May 2026).
requisitoNotas.USD 30 (15 días), 50 (30 días) o 125 (90: USD 30 (15 days), 50 (30 days) or 125 (90 days). Passport valid for 6 months. Can also be processed at embassies.
requisitoNotas.e-Visa turista 30 días: USD 25 (jul-mar): 30-day tourist e-Visa: USD 25 (Jul–Mar), USD 10 (Apr–Jun). Apply between 120 and 4 days before. 1- and 5-year versions also exist.
requisitoNotas.No requiere visa. SG Arrival Card online: No visa required. Free online SG Arrival Card before arriving. ICA sets the length of stay on entry (not published by country).
requisitoNotas.Exención unilateral temporal hasta el 31: Temporary unilateral exemption until 31 Dec 2026, max. 30 days (tourism, business, visits, transit). Check whether it is extended.
requisitoNotas.Visa Visitor 600 vía ImmiAccount; chilen: Visitor visa 600 via ImmiAccount; Chileans cannot use the ETA. Fee ~AUD 250 according to unofficial sources (check with Home Affairs).
requisitoNotas.NZeTA desde NZD 17 + tasa IVL NZD 100 (~: NZeTA from NZD 17 + IVL levy NZD 100 (~USD 68 total). Apply ≥72 h before; valid for 2 years; up to 3 months per visit.
requisitoNotas.Fuera de Schengen, régimen propio: exent: Outside Schengen, with its own rules: exempt for up to 3 months every 6. The official list (Annex II, 2011 decree) could not be opened to confirm Chile.
requisitoNotas.No hay visa ni control migratorio; el tu: There is no visa or immigration control; tourism is done with authorized operators (Chilean Foreign Ministry, Law 21,255). If you depart from Argentina, its requirements apply.
requisitoNotas.Territorio de EE.UU.: ESTA USD 40 y pasa: US territory: ESTA USD 40 and an e-passport. Valid for 2 years; response within 72 h. Max. 90 days per trip.
requisitoNotas.Exentos para estadías de hasta 30 días (: Exempt for stays of up to 30 days (extendable at Immigration). Passport valid for 3 months, onward ticket and funds.
requisitoNotas.Chile exento de visa. Obligatorio llenar: Chile is visa-exempt. The Digital Immigration Card (free) at dicardcuracao.com is mandatory before arriving. Maximum stay not officially confirmed.
requisitoNotas.Hasta 90 días sin visa para pasaporte or: Up to 90 days without a visa for ordinary Chilean passports. Bring an onward ticket and proof of accommodation.
requisitoNotas.ETIAS aún no vigente (CE: inicio previst: ETIAS not in force yet (EC: expected start Q4 2026). EES (biometric registration) in force since 10 Apr 2026.
ETIAS not in force yet (EC: expected start Q4 2026). EES (biometric registration) in force since 10 Apr 2026. Source: EU list (Belgium refers to it).
Not Schengen: ETIAS and EES do not apply. Up to 90 days according to the entry stamp. If you go through the UK/Northern Ireland, the UK requires its ETA.
requisitoNotas.Hasta 90 días con pasaporte válido. No e: Up to 90 days with a valid passport. Not Schengen: days here do not count toward the EU 90/180 limit.
requisitoNotas.Sin visa solo con pasaporte (tabla MRE s: No visa, passport only (Foreign Ministry table, Sept. 2024). 90 days in 180 under general Albanian rules. Not Schengen.
requisitoNotas.No son Schengen; quien entra a Dinamarca: Not Schengen; anyone who can enter Denmark without a visa can also enter the Faroes without one (up to 90 days). Usually reached via Denmark (Schengen).
requisitoNotas.Hasta 90 días sin visa. Régimen propio d: Up to 90 days without a visa. Hong Kong's own rules: it does not allow entry to mainland China.
requisitoNotas.Hasta 90 días. Pasaporte con 6 meses de: Up to 90 days. Passport valid for 6 months. Fill in the online arrival card (TWAC) within the 7 days before.
requisitoNotas.e-Visa solo en evisa.gov.kh (puede haber: e-Visa only at evisa.gov.kh (there may be an extra charge). Passport valid for 6 months. e-Arrival Card mandatory 7 days before (since 2025).
requisitoNotas.Chile elegible para e-Visa (laoevisa.gov: Chile is eligible for the e-Visa (laoevisa.gov.la, ~3 business days, only certain border points). 30 days, extendable. Fee not confirmed.
requisitoNotas.14 días no prorrogables. Requiere pasapo: 14 days, not extendable. Requires a passport valid for 6 months, return ticket, hotel booking, health insurance and funds. For more days: e-Visa.
requisitoNotas.Chile está en la lista de exención de vi: Chile is on the visa-exemption list for up to 30 days.
requisitoNotas.Exención bilateral vigente desde 29/12/2: Bilateral exemption in force since 29 Dec 2018 for all types of Chilean passports, up to 90 days.
requisitoNotas.Visa US$40 vía immi.gov.bt o agencia/hot: Visa US$40 via immi.gov.bt or an agency/hotel; review takes up to 5 business days. Plus an SDF fee of US$100 per night per adult.
requisitoNotas.Chile en lista de visa a la llegada (cir: Chile is on the visa-on-arrival list (2025 circular). Fee N$1,600 (~US$90). e-Visa also available at eservices.mhaiss.gov.na.
requisitoNotas.Sin visa (tabla oficial 2022). Llenar el: No visa (official 2022 table). Fill in the digital All-in-One form (safemauritius.govmu.org). The officer sets the length on arrival.
requisitoNotas.Travel Authorisation obligatoria antes d: Travel Authorisation required before traveling, only at seychelles.govtas.com (€10 standard). Free visitor permit for up to 3 months.
requisitoNotas.Desde 16/02/2026: €30 hasta 15 días, €35: Since 16 Feb 2026: €30 up to 15 days, €35 up to 30, €40 up to 60, €50 up to 90. The official portal could not be opened.
requisitoNotas.Chile NO está en la lista de exentos. Pr: Chile is NOT on the exempt list. EASE pre-registration 5 days before and TSA fee 3,400 CVE (~US$35). Visa at the border only if there is no embassy.
requisitoNotas.Visa turismo 30 días US$50 (múltiple 90: 30-day tourist visa US$50 (90-day multiple US$70). Obtained on arrival or online at irembo.gov.rw. Chile is not exempt.
requisitoNotas.Chile en la lista oficial de países sin: Chile is on the official list of visa-free countries. 90 days per year according to a secondary source (not officially confirmed).
requisitoNotas.Chile exento de visa; en frontera se oto: Chile is visa-exempt; a 4-month visitor permit is granted at the border. Bring an onward ticket.
requisitoNotas.La cédula de identidad chilena vigente e: A valid Chilean ID card is a valid travel document (Mercosur agreement). Tourist stay of up to 90 days (approximate).
requisitoNotas.Chile está en la lista de exención de vi: Chile is on the 30-day visa-exemption list. Fill in the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) online and free of charge within the 3 days before arriving.
